items.title: President Trump Nominates Bipartisan Slate for SEC and CFTC commissioners
items.summary: President Donald Trump has nominated a bipartisan group of commissioners to fill vacancies at the SEC and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

items.title: Amazon MGM confirms Robert Pattinson as James Bond, bringing production insurance into focus
items.summary: Amazon MGM Studios has confirmed Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, prompting a close look at how underwriters price high-budget film production risks.

items.title: Chubb rejects claims made by former Australia chief Ben Howell
items.summary: Chubb has defended itself against Federal Court action brought by its former Australia and New Zealand president, stating an independent review found the claims baseless.

items.title: Ageas survey reveals high consumer worry over identity fraud
items.summary: Research published by Ageas UK shows widespread concern about identity theft among insurance customers, alongside gaps in consumer understanding.

items.title: UK road casualties reach highest level since 2018 as motor insurers face rising claims costs
items.summary: Official figures show UK road deaths and serious injuries rose 4% in 2025, adding pressure to motor insurers managing record claims payouts.

items.title: Shepherds Friendly, Consilium and Adler Fairways announce executive appointments
items.summary: Recent insurance industry moves cover a new finance chief at Shepherds Friendly, wholesale broker appointments in Jamaica, and leadership changes at Adler Fairways.
